items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: But we went in that band together. I never forgot that. It was September, '37.

ctx.x: Was it Teddy Buckner that plays now? trumpet near
Ted Buckner -- no, it was a saxophone player, Milt Buckner's brother. Milt Buckner, the piano and organ player used to play with Hamp. They were from Detroit. No relation to this Teddy Buckner.
